## Resend - Backend Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/resend/c4c5eb8c-e6ac-49f5-9dc7-a68ce0948929)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend Engineer building Resend’s SMTP and email transport infrastructure. Designing reliable delivery, throttling, routing, and reputation-aware systems for developers.
Backend Engineer building Resend’s high-volume email transport infrastructure
- Salary: $150,000 - $170,000 per year
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, DNS, SMTP, TypeScript, Go
- Build and operate Resend’s email transport infrastructure
- Work on SMTP delivery, MTA systems, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls
- Design domain-level, provider-level, customer-level, and IP-level throttling systems
- Build infrastructure for shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing
- Improve classification of bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and delivery outcomes
- Build debugging tools for delivery issues by customer, domain, mailbox provider, route, IP, message type, and event
- Design systems that make sending behavior safer, more observable, and easier to operate
- Translate reputation strategy into backend systems
- Strong backend engineering experience
- Experience with email, messaging, notifications, communications, infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems
- Understanding of queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems
- Experience or strong interest in SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior
- Care about reliability, observability, operational excellence, and reducing blast radius
- Low ego, high ownership, and strong taste for simple systems
- Experience working on applications with a high workload
- Willingness to learn more about email best practices

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend Engineer building Resend’s SMTP and email transport infrastructure. Designing reliable delivery, throttling, routing, and reputation-aware systems for developers.
Backend Engineer building Resend’s high-volume email transport infrastructure
Role description:
• Build and operate Resend’s email transport infrastructure
• Work on SMTP delivery, MTA systems, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls
• Design domain-level, provider-level, customer-level, and IP-level throttling systems
• Build infrastructure for shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing
• Improve classification of bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and delivery outcomes
• Build debugging tools for delivery issues by customer, domain, mailbox provider, route, IP, message type, and event
• Design systems that make sending behavior safer, more observable, and easier to operate
• Translate reputation strategy into backend systems
• Partner with Trust & Safety and Core Sending to build anti-abuse controls
• Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues
• Be on-call for critical services
Role requirements:
• Strong backend engineering experience
• Experience with email, messaging, notifications, communications, infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems
• Understanding of queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems
• Experience or strong interest in SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior
• Care about reliability, observability, operational excellence, and reducing blast radius
• Low ego, high ownership, and strong taste for simple systems
• Experience working on applications with a high workload
• Willingness to learn more about email best practices
• Experience in Typescript and Golang
Benefits:
• Autonomy to "just ship it"
• 100% remote team with flexible working schedules
• Modern tech stack (Typescript, AWS, Go, Postgres, Datadog)
• Honest and low-ego team
• Ownership of problems and solutions
• Some expected travel for team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and more
Tech stack:
Distributed Systems, DNS, SMTP, TypeScript, Go
